Excluding the restructuring spend related to recent acquisit

excluded_uids: 5 P1-B tasks (3117a2bf, cf179156, 0dc550d6, 34e4e2e9, d8b972a6) + all main120/frozen200
task_role: these 4 tasks are CALIBRATION tasks: used for L-scale calibration AND mechanism validation; NOT independent test tasks; excluded from any subsequent formal experiment
config: DYNAMICDAG node-level: e1=large, e2=large, r=medium, v=coder (same X for all scenarios)

scenarios.order_rationale: S1 populates cache → S4 immediately verifies reuse → S2/S3 add recovery/FULL on warm cache

S1_no_recovery.purpose: cold baseline: all planned nodes execute; populates shared cache
S1_no_recovery.expected_new_requests_per_task: 4 (cold, no prior cache for these prompts)
S1_no_recovery.cache_sharing: results written to SHARED run cache

S4_cache_reuse.purpose: verify legitimate cache reuse: all calls should hit S1's cache
S4_cache_reuse.cache_sharing: reads from SHARED cache (S1's entries); writes back (no-op if identical)

S2_local_reroute.fault: directed r-node synthetic_unparseable_r (from P1-B Plan-A frozen injection)
S2_local_reroute.purpose: verify local recovery billing: faulted r uses clean-ref cost (no extra request); r_esc is a new request; v_fbd if r_changed_final=True
S2_local_reroute.expected_new_requests_per_task: r_esc (1) + v_fbd (0-1) + possible e-node if not cached = 1-3 (e1/e2/v-planned may hit S1 cache)
S2_local_reroute.injection_note: injection REPLACES the answer AFTER obtaining the response for cost metering; does NOT produce an extra model request; the 4th planned call still occurs (billed attempt)
S2_local_reroute.cache_sharing: e1/e2 prompts identical to S1 → cache hit; r/v prompts differ (fault/recovery) → new requests

S3_full_replay.purpose: verify FULL: all 4 nodes re-executed logically after detection; cache reuse allowed for identical prompts
S3_full_replay.expected_logical_calls_per_task: 4 planned + 4 full-replay = 8 (injection is answer-replacement, not extra call)
S3_full_replay.expected_new_requests_per_task: 0-4 depending on cache overlap with S1/S2; e1/e2 replay prompts = same as S1 → likely cached; r replay with fault context may differ → new; v replay after r change → new
S3_full_replay.acceptance: verify all 4 nodes traverse FULL logical re-execution path (even if cache hit), with correct per-node billing separation
S3_full_replay.cache_sharing: reads from SHARED cache; accepts hits for identical prompts

budget.scope: SINGLE GLOBAL budget across ALL scenarios (not per-scenario)
budget.budget_counter: persisted to disk; global across scenarios; no reset
budget.insufficient_budget: stop; log partial results; record which scenarios completed vs pending

may_be_partial: S3_full_replay (any number of tasks; mechanism evidence from partial acceptable)
minimum_completion.insufficient_budget_action: if budget exhausted before must_complete: log as VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE; do not claim FULL verification

cache_sharing_rules.shared_cache: single cache identity: (model, prompt_sha256) across ALL scenarios in this validation
cache_sharing_rules.S1_populates: S1 is executed first specifically to populate the cache
cache_sharing_rules.S4_reads: S4 uses identical prompts → must find S1 entries
cache_sharing_rules.S2_S3_partial: S2/S3 may find e1/e2 entries from S1 (same model+prompt); recovery-path prompts are new
cache_sharing_rules.prohibited: no cross-validation-set cache leakage; this cache is validation-local

latency_calibration.record_per_call: serial service-demand (individual latency_s from MeteredExecutor) AND task wall-clock (time.monotonic from first to last call per task)
latency_calibration.wall_clock_semantics: wall-clock includes queueing/scheduling under batch processing; recorded as DIAGNOSTIC, not used as optimization objective
latency_calibration.serial_reconstruction_semantics: sum of individual service latencies; this is the L optimization target
latency_calibration.current_scale: L_SCALE=(0,12) is PLACEHOLDER from Cube critical-path; TO BE RECALIBRATED
latency_calibration.calibration_procedure: after S1 completes: new_L_max = max(observed serial reconstruction across S1 tasks) * 1.4; frozen as L_SCALE_v2 BEFORE S2/S3; version-tagged; not adjustable from formal test results
latency_calibration.these_tasks_are: calibration tasks — L scale from here applies to subsequent formal experiments; these tasks excluded from formal experiment task pool

acceptance_evidence.per_node: node, model, prompt_sha256, raw answer head, parsed result, latency_s, tokens — every call
acceptance_evidence.billing_separation: logical_calls, injected_calls, cache_hits, new_requests, new_tokens, new_latency_s, wall_clock_s — per task per scenario
acceptance_evidence.quality: Q from JointEvaluator formal path; gold only post-hoc
acceptance_evidence.cache_provenance: each cache_hit annotated with source (which scenario's execution)

stopping_rules.normal: all scenarios complete within global budget
stopping_rules.budget_exhaustion: stop immediately; log which scenarios completed; status=partial
stopping_rules.infrastructure_failure: stop; no retry; preserve partial ledger
stopping_rules.unexpected_pattern: S4 producing new requests → stop; investigate cache identity mismatch

outstanding_after_this_validation: cost predictor accuracy under real costs
L scale v2 freeze (from this validation's calibration data)

non_claims: No method comparison (single config, mechanism focus)
No final L scale (placeholder until calibrated from this data)
